name: hdl_weekly_health_check
description: Submit health and longevity assessments for a Lab test agent, triggering real Make.com PDF reports.

steps.name: load_persona
steps.prompt: Load the agent persona config from data/hdl_personas/{param.agent_name}.json. Parse the JSON and store it for use in subsequent steps.

steps.name: check_credits
steps.prompt: Check the credit status for {param.email} using the hdl_tools.check_user_status() function. If health or longevity credits are below 10, call hdl_tools.reset_credits() to top up by 100.

steps.name: generate_health_data
steps.prompt: Using the persona config from step 1 and any previous submission history, generate realistic health assessment form data using hdl_form_builders.build_health_form_data(). The data should show gradual progression consistent with the persona's trajectory (improving, stable, or declining). Add natural variance to simulate real human data.

steps.name: submit_health
steps.prompt: Submit the generated health assessment data using hdl_tools.submit_health_assessment(email='{param.email}', form_data=<health_data>, agent_name='{param.agent_name}'). Record the submission_id and dashboard_url from the response.

steps.name: generate_longevity_data
steps.prompt: Generate realistic longevity assessment data using hdl_form_builders.build_longevity_form_data(). This includes all 16 lifestyle scores (0-5 scale), biological age calculation, BMI, WHR, and answer text descriptions. Ensure scores are consistent with the health data just submitted.

steps.name: submit_longevity
steps.prompt: Submit the longevity assessment using hdl_tools.submit_longevity_assessment(). This triggers Make.com to generate a PDF report which will be emailed to the test email. Record the response including make_status.

steps.name: verify
steps.prompt: Call hdl_tools.check_user_status() again to verify both submissions landed successfully. Check that credits decreased by 2 (1 health + 1 longevity) and that the daily usage count increased.

steps.name: log_to_notion
steps.prompt: Log the results to the 'HDL Lab Test Log' Notion database with: Date (today), Agent ({param.agent_name}), Form Type (Health + Longevity), Status (Success/Failed based on verify step), Credits Remaining (from verify), Submission IDs (from submit steps), PDF Triggered (true if make_status was 'sent').

params.agent_name: Name of the agent (bob, alice, charlie, diana, echo)
